svg.title: Five Service Niches, One Recognized-Revenue Basis
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-service-package-revenue-yields; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Five Service Niches, One Recognized-Revenue Basis; subtitle: Annual service fees per client; four clients in each niche.; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Bar lengths show illustrative annual operator service fees per client in USD, not observed market prices, contract award values, or profit margins. Each client belongs to one primary service package; no client is counted in two bars.; caption: Four clients per package yield $160,000 + $120,000 + $112,000 + $96,000 + $72,000 = $560,000. Package pricing must support documented work rather than payments for influence.; stages: label: Federal technical-services capture; value: $40,000 annual service fees per client; numeric value: 40000.0; detail: Four clients contribute $160,000 through capability mapping, solicitation analysis, and recurring capture coordination. Invoice contracted monthly services; keep the client's technical solution and bid pricing under client ownership.; label: Municipal facilities bid operations; value: $30,000 annual service fees per client; numeric value: 30000.0; detail: Four clients contribute $120,000 through local portal monitoring, site-visit scheduling, document assembly, and amendment control. Maintain separate jurisdiction rules instead of applying federal clauses indiscriminately.; label: Prime/sub teaming administration; value: $28,000 annual service fees per client; numeric value: 28000.0; detail: Four clients contribute $112,000 through capability verification, workshare documentation, and teaming records. Charge for actual support work; review FAR 9.6, applicable pass-through clauses, and set-aside performance limits.; label: Public-supply solicitation desk; value: $24,000 annual service fees per client; numeric value: 24000.0; detail: Four clients contribute $96,000 through specification crosswalks, supplier confirmations, lead-time tracking, and bid assembly. Identify applicable domestic-source and nonmanufacturer requirements before pursuing supply awards.; label: Post-submission administration; value: $18,000 annual service fees per client; numeric value: 18000.0; detail: Four clients contribute $72,000 through status tracking, client-directed clarification coordination, document retention, and service reporting. Keep authorized government communications distinct from unsolicited access selling.

text.title: Five Service Niches, One Recognized-Revenue Basis
text.tspan: Five Service Niches, One Recognized-Revenue Basis

rect.title: label: Federal technical-services capture; value: $40,000 annual service fees per client; numeric value: 40000.0; detail: Four clients contribute $160,000 through capability mapping, solicitation analysis, and recurring capture coordination. Invoice contracted monthly services; keep the client's technical solution and bid pricing under client ownership.

label: Municipal facilities bid operations; value: $30,000 annual service fees per client; numeric value: 30000.0; detail: Four clients contribute $120,000 through local portal monitoring, site-visit scheduling, document assembly, and amendment control. Maintain separate jurisdiction rules instead of applying federal clauses indiscriminately.

label: Prime/sub teaming administration; value: $28,000 annual service fees per client; numeric value: 28000.0; detail: Four clients contribute $112,000 through capability verification, workshare documentation, and teaming records. Charge for actual support work; review FAR 9.6, applicable pass-through clauses, and set-aside performance limits.

label: Public-supply solicitation desk; value: $24,000 annual service fees per client; numeric value: 24000.0; detail: Four clients contribute $96,000 through specification crosswalks, supplier confirmations, lead-time tracking, and bid assembly. Identify applicable domestic-source and nonmanufacturer requirements before pursuing supply awards.

label: Post-submission administration; value: $18,000 annual service fees per client; numeric value: 18000.0; detail: Four clients contribute $72,000 through status tracking, client-directed clarification coordination, document retention, and service reporting. Keep authorized government communications distinct from unsolicited access selling.

text.title: Assumptions: Bar lengths show illustrative annual operator service fees per client in USD, not observed market prices, contract award values, or profit margins. Each client belongs to one primary service package; no client is counted in two bars.
